This custom block holds all of the code for the individual particles, with all of its parameters.

LIFETIME: How long the particle will live for, IN SECONDS.

SIZE: The starting size of the particle. Be aware that sprites have a limit to how small they can be.

X SPEED: The starting speed for the particle on the X axis.

Y SPEED: The starting speed for the particle on the Y axis.

GRAVITY: How fast the particle falls 

FRICTION (0 - 1.0): How quickly the particle will slow down on the X axis as it hits the ground.
(0 stop the particles immediately, 1 will never slow down the particle.)

BOUNCINESS (0 - 1.0): How high the particle will bounce of the ground.
(0 results in no bounciness, 1 results in the particle bouncing forever.)
